simple.meaning: a marsh ; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds

definitions.short: a marsh ; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds
definitions.full: H98. agam אֲגַם noun [masculine] troubled pool (Aramaic id. , , Assyrian agammu Dl W ) — ׳א absolute Isa 35:7 ; construct 41:18 2 t.; אֲגַמִּים Exod 8:1-2 t.; אַגְמֵי Isa 14:23 ; אַגְמֵיהֶם Exod 7:19 — 1 troubled or muddy (gloomy) pools or marshes , plural ׳א מַיִם Isa 14:23 . 2 any pool, pond , singular ׳א מַיִם Isa 41:18 ; Psa 107:35 ; 114:8 ; plural without מַיִם Exod 7:19 ; 8:1 (P) Isa 42:15 . 3 swamp-reed, rush (= אַגְמוֺן ) Jer 51:32 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water);
